Article Title: 'He walked into room with tattoos': Rahul Gandhi remembers Sidhu Moosewala at 'Insaaf' rally in Punjab, recalls their first meeting
Article Text:
Recalling the concern he felt during that meeting, Rahul said he had sensed that Moosewala was stepping into a dangerous environment by entering politics. He said he wanted to offer the young singer political protection and help him feel comfortable in the party.

Rahul Gandhi attacks Bhagwant Mann over drug menace

NEW DELHI: Congress MP Rahul Gandhi fondly remembered late Punjabi singer Sidhu Moosewala at the party's 'Insaaf Rally' on Wednesday. The leader of the opposition in Lok Sabha recalled his first meeting with the singer and described him as an impressive, dynamic and talented young man. Inviting Moosewala's father onto the stage, Rahul Gandhi recounted how the singer had walked into his office with tattoos and made an impression on him even before he had heard any of his songs. He also recalled feeling that Moosewala was entering a dangerous field when he decided to join politics.Rahul said he had not known much about Moosewala when they first met a few years ago. He had not heard his music or even his voice. However, the singer's personality and the impression he made during their interaction led Rahul to induct him into the Congress."A few years ago, I met his son at my office. At that time, I did not know Sidhu Moosewala. I was meeting him for the first time and did not know much about him. He was an impressive young man. He walked into the room with tattoos. I had not heard his songs or even his voice at that time. I was only told that he was a good person, a musician, and wanted to join the Congress party . As politicians, we observe people carefully when they come to meet us.We do not rely too much on their words; we go by our feelings and what our heart tells us about them. He was a dynamic and talented young man, so I inducted him into the party."Recalling the concern he felt during that meeting, the leader of opposition said he had sensed that Moosewala was stepping into a dangerous environment by entering politics. He said he wanted to offer the young singer political protection and help him feel comfortable in the party."During our meeting, a thought suddenly crossed my mind, though nobody had told me anything about it. I felt that he was entering a dangerous field. I don't know why I got that feeling. He was a singer, a dynamic young man, and someone who did not understand politics very well. I felt I should protect him in my own way. I did not mean physical protection; that thought had not even crossed my mind. I meant political protection. He was a young man entering politics, and I wanted him to feel comfortable in that environment."Moosewala was shot dead in May 2022 in Punjab's Mansa district. His killing had triggered widespread outrage and questions over the state's law-and-order situation.Rahul Gandhi had also invoked Moosewala's memory during the 2024 Lok Sabha elections. When asked how many seats the INDIA bloc would win, he responded with a seemingly cryptic "295". The number was widely seen as a reference to Moosewala's popular song 295, adding another instance of the Congress leader's association with the late singer.Rahul Gandhi also targeted Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann and the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) government over the drug problem in the state. Questioning the party's promise to eradicate drug abuse, he asked what parts of Punjab had been freed from the menace since the AAP came to power."The Aam Aadmi Party came to power, and you placed your trust in it. Punjab trusted Bhagwant Mann and the Aam Aadmi Party. What was their promise? That they would eradicate drug abuse. I want to ask you... Where have they eradicated drugs? From which part of Punjab have they managed to eliminate the drug menace? They cannot eradicate drugs."He also alleged that Mann's breath would smell of alcohol during their interactions in Parliament. Rahul said the chief minister would sit with MPs and crack jokes early in the morning, but that the smell of alcohol would be noticeable by 11am.Clarifying that he was not questioning Mann's personal choice to consume alcohol, Rahul said a chief minister leading a campaign against drug abuse could not himself be under the influence of intoxicants."Let me tell you another story about your chief minister. When I was in the Lok Sabha, he would sit with us early in the morning and crack jokes. However, by 11 am, his breath would smell of alcohol. I am not saying that Bhagwant Mann should not consume alcohol. That is his personal matter. If he wants to drink, it is his personal choice. But if you want to fight drug abuse, your chief minister cannot be under the influence of intoxicants every evening. "
Article Summary: Rahul Gandhi fondly remembered late Punjabi singer Sidhu Moosewala at the party's 'Insaaf Rally' The leader of the opposition in Lok Sabha recalled his first meeting with the singer and described him as an impressive, dynamic and talented young man. He said he wanted to offer the young singer political protection and help him feel comfortable in the party.

Article Title: Dilip Ghosh takes 'Sonia' jibe at Mamata for joining INDIA bloc rally against SIR
Article Text:
Ghosh claimed that Banerjee's party has lost political ground in its state and that she was seeking political relevance by aligning with the Congress leadership.

Festive season security arrangements

Ghosh targets Mamata over development boards

NEW DELHI: West Bengal minister Dilip Ghosh on Tuesday criticised former chief minister Mamata Banerjee for attending the INDIA bloc rally at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Taking a dig at Mamata, he said that she was turning to Congress leader Sonia Gandhi for leadership out of "utter helplessness".Ghosh claimed that Banerjee's party has lost political ground in its state and that she was seeking political relevance by aligning with the Congress leadership.“Earlier, she set out to become the top leader herself. Now, she has nothing left in her hands. Today, she isn’t even an elected representative. That is why, out of utter helplessness, she goes around accepting Sonia ji as her leader again. Her party is finished today,” news agency ANI reported, quoting Ghosh.He also hit out at Banerjee over her objections to the electoral process, saying political parties must respect the people's mandate. He alleged that she had no complaints about the Election Commission or democracy when her party was winning elections.“As long as she was winning, democracy was fine, and the Election Commission was fine. The moment she lost, everything went wrong. Keep faith in the people; the people decide who wins and who loses. One must accept the verdict of the public,” he said.The minister further claimed that the removal of fake voters during the electoral roll revision had paved the way for free and fair elections in West Bengal. He alleged that Banerjee had benefited from such voters in previous elections.“Look, when the revision occurred, the fake voter base through which Mamata used to win was eliminated. Once they were separated, a free and fair election took place. A genuine election happened in Bengal after many years, and people are happy about it; change has arrived. No outsider can simply enter and become a citizen of this country or avail benefits here,” he said.Ghosh also said the ruling government and party workers would organise rallies across the state to counter the Opposition's attempts to create unrest and communicate their position to the public.“It is also our responsibility to make people understand and deliver the right message. The people are nationalist, and the government is nationalist. No one will be permitted to create unrest in the country. We will also reach out to the people and hold rallies everywhere; this is just the beginning,” he said.Meanwhile, Ghosh said the state government was making arrangements to ensure that Deepavali, Kali Puja and Jagaddhatri Puja celebrations passed off peacefully.He said every cabinet minister had been assigned a district to oversee law and order during the festive season. Ghosh has been given responsibility for Purba Medinipur, also known as East Midnapore.“The government is keeping a close watch across all of West Bengal to ensure that the upcoming Deepavali, Kali Puja, and Jagaddhatri Puja are conducted smoothly and with enthusiasm. Every cabinet minister has been assigned the responsibility of overseeing law and order in one district. I have been given charge of Purba Medinipur (East Midnapore). I am also meeting with them to ensure all arrangements are in place and nothing goes wrong. This is the government’s duty, and the public must cooperate,” he said.The minister also criticised the previous Trinamool Congress government over the functioning of development boards set up for marginalised communities, including the Matua community.He alleged that several boards formed during Banerjee's tenure had not received adequate funds or been given meaningful work.“Mamata Banerjee had formed several development boards in West Bengal: the Rajbanshi Board, the Matua Board, the Bhumij Adivasi Board, but gave neither funds nor work to anyone. She only played politics,” he said.Ghosh said the Matua community, many of whose members migrated from Bangladesh, continued to face economic hardships and needed focused development measures. He said the board should be made functional and provided with funds.“Now, for that community, especially the Matua community, most of whom came from Bangladesh, have numerous hardships and are poor. Their development must happen; therefore, the board must be actively functional for them, and funds must be provided, which our chief minister (Suvendu Adhikari) has initiated," he said.
Article Summary: West Bengal minister Dilip Ghosh criticised former chief minister Mamata Banerjee for attending the INDIA bloc rally at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Ghosh claimed that Banerée's party has lost political ground in its state and that she was seeking political relevance by aligning with the Congress leadership.

Article Title: EC: Okay to use Form 6 for re-inclusion in rolls
Article Text:
Section 31 of the RP Act provides for imprisonment up to a year or fine or both, for anyone making a false declaration during updation of rolls

EC clarifies deleted voters can seek re-inclusion through Form 6 during SIR without facing prosecution for false declaration

Declaration prescribed under Form 6 has been in force since Aug 1, 2022: EC

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Election Commission Tuesday clarified that no action will be taken against a previous elector, whose name is deleted from draft rolls published during Special Intensive Revision (SIR), who seeks re-inclusion by filling Form 6.The declaration that the voter's name is being included in the electoral roll for the first time will not be liable for prosecution under election laws for making a false statement, EC said in a communication to chief electoral officers (CEOs) of states and UTs.Recalling a Delhi HC order dated Oct 14 that held as "misplaced" the apprehension of an applicant, who argued that submitting Form 6 would amount to making a false declaration, EC directed that "no action shall be initiated under Section 31 of the R P Act by an ERO against an elector merely on the ground that the elector had been included in a previous electoral roll and has submitted Form 6 during the SIR process or afterwards, provided the elector is not already enrolled in any other parliamentary or assembly constituency and the declaration made is otherwise in accordance with law".Stating that submission of Form 6 for inclusion afresh under SIR or afterwards is not, by itself, false merely because the elector was previously enrolled, EC on Tuesday instructed chief electoral officers of states and UTs that no action should be initiated by electoral registration officers (ERO) against such electors under Section 31 of the Representation of the People (RP) Act, 1950. Section 31 of the RP Act provides for imprisonment up to a year or fine or both, for anyone making a false declaration during preparation or updation of electoral roll.Certain previous electors, whose names did not figure in the draft electoral roll published during SIR, have been hesitant to submit Form 6 as they are also required to furnish a declaration prescribed in Form 6 that their name is being included for the first time in the electoral roll.They believe that this would amount to falsehood in view of their previous enrolment, attracting Section 31. Stressing that the declaration prescribed under Form 6 has been in force since Aug 1, 2022, the poll body clarified that an elector whose name does not appear in the draft electoral roll may submit Form 6 to seek inclusion in the final electoral roll, “in accordance with the prescribed procedure,” both under SIR and afterwards, irrespective of whether such elector was enrolled previously.
Article Summary: EC clarifies deleted voters can seek re-inclusion through Form 6 during SIR without facing prosecution for false declaration.Declaration prescribed under Form 6 has been in force since Aug 1, 2022: EC. Section 31 of the RP Act provides for imprisonment up to a year or fine or both, for anyone making a false declaration during updation of rolls.

Article Title: 'Do you want Rahul vs PM Modi open debate?' Congress leader runs up public poll; asks BJP top brass to convince

NEW DELHI: Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi doubled down on his call for a debate with Prime Minister Narendra Modi over allegations of "foreign backing" levelled by both rival parties. His Congress and the BJP "Do you want to see a Rahul Gandhi vs Narendra Modi open debate?" the Congress leader wrote on X while posting a poll that contained two tricky options: "Yes, Modi Ji, Daro Mat" and "No, Modi Ji, Dar Gaye".The Congress leader, in a quirky note, also asked BJP's top brass, which includes some of PM Modi's colleagues in the Cabinet, to convince the Prime Minister to agree to a debate."Rajnath Singh Ji, Nitin Gadkari Ji, Shivraj Singh Chouhan Ji, Yogi Adityanath Ji, you you always have the PM’s best interest in mind, please convince him to come," the Congress scion quipped in the post.The Rae Bareli Lok Sabha MP posted the poll hours after he renewed his challenge to PM Modi to face him in an open debate, saying 24 hours had passed since he dared the PM.In a video shared on X, Rahul said, “24 hours have passed, Modi ji. I challenged you. You say that the opposition is anti-national. Pick any stage, any venue, and debate me.”“Who is the anti-national? Who has connections with foreign forces? And what kind of connections are they? Do it as soon as possible, don't be afraid,” he said.On Monday, Rahul had challenged the Prime Minister to an open debate on allegations of him becoming Prime Minister with "foreign help", saying the latter would not dare to accept it.The whole showdown began after Rahul retorted to Modi's 'Ekta Diwas' speech, in which the PM accused the opposition of turning into an "obstructionist force" (avrodh paksh).The Prime Minister also warned against forces "engaged in conspiracies to divide" the country, saying social media was "being weaponised, rumours being spread, and attempts being made to tarnish India's image"."When the country was seeking solutions to external challenges, some forces within the country were also creating instability by spreading lies and rumours. But the countrymen stood shoulder to shoulder with the nation," PM Modi said.“It is our misfortune that at this time in the country, the opposition has turned into an Avrodh Paksh rather than Virodh Paksh. In their frustration, these people are standing as obstacles in the way of the country’s development.This is not opposition; this is obstruction,” he added.In a veiled reference to Rahul's foreign trips, he said, “Due to the frustration of more than a decade, these people have now come out in the open. Who is secretly meeting whom abroad? Whom are the anti-India forces supporting? Who is speaking the language of India’s enemies? We will have to recognise all these patterns.”
Article Summary: Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi doubled down on his call for a debate with Prime Minister Narendra Modi over allegations of "foreign backing" The Congress leader, in a quirky note, also asked BJP's top brass, which includes some of PM Modi's colleagues in the Cabinet, to convince the PM to agree to a debate.

Article Title: Judge needn't face strictures for typos in judgement: SC
Article Text:
SC sets aside Rajasthan HC’s strictures against a trial judge over inadvertent errors in a judgment, ruling that the remarks were unwarranted as the errors did not affect the case outcome

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Some factual errors in a judgement delivered by her, allegedly due to a 'cut, copy and paste' job, had cost a trial judge dear, resulting in Rajasthan HC castigating her and sending her to a judicial academy for training. But Supreme Court has come to the judge's rescue and struck off the adverse observations against her, holding that criticising a judicial officer for inadvertent typographical errors in a judgement, which did not affect the outcome of the case, was unwarranted.A bench of Justices Sandeep Mehta and Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya allowed the plea of the judge and expunged the strictures and adverse remarks against her."Ex facie, we feel that the adverse observations and the strictures recorded by HC against the judicial officer were uncalled for and avoidable. These disparaging remarks and the strictures were recorded on the judicial side without affording an opportunity to the judicial officer to show-cause or to place her explanation on record before such observations and strictures were made, and hence, suffer from the vice of nonadherence to the principles of natural justice," it said.HC observed the judicial officer "had used the methodology of 'cut, copy and paste' and in all probability, the judgement had been scripted by the stenographer/clerk concerned and was signed without being read and corrected by the presiding officer as she failed to strike out the irrelevant paragraphs which related to the trial of the adult accused".The trial judge had passed two judgements arising out of the same case as one of the accused was a minor. After appreciating the evidence in both trials, the judicial officer pronounced separate judgements convicting both the accused of the charges against them and sentencing each to 20 years' RI.SC said it seemed that during the course of rendering judgements in the two cases, some extracts of evidence/numerical details from one trial were inadvertently incorporated into the judgement for the other.
Article Summary: SC sets aside Rajasthan HC’s strictures against a trial judge over inadvertent errors in a judgment. Justices Sandeep Mehta and Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya allowed the judge and expunged the strictures and adverse remarks against her.

NEW DELHI: Union minister Hardeep Puri is set to win the upcoming Rajya Sabha bypoll unopposed from Madhya Pradesh after the nomination papers filed by two candidates were rejected by the returning officer.According to news agency PTI, the nominations of Congress-backed candidates Rajkumar Lohani and Kante Sayanna were rejected on the last day of scrutiny.Meanwhile, the two independent candidates, along with Congress leader Hemant Katare, also objected to Puri's nomination papers, contending that his affidavit in Form 26 was invalid and incomplete.However, returning officer Umesh Sharma examined the objections and held that Puri had not violated any requirements of the Representation of the People Act."No defect was found in Puri's papers," the returning officer said in his order.Congress termed the order an "attack on Indian democracy" and said it would move court against it."This is an attack on Indian democracy. Despite such significant errors, the nomination was not rejected," Katare and Congress MLA Atif Aqeel said in a statement.The bypoll was necessitated by the resignation of former Union minister L Murugan, who vacated the seat on October 14.His term in the Rajya Sabha was originally scheduled to end on April 2, 2030.The Election Commission announced the schedule for the bypoll on October 22.According to the schedule, the notification for the election will be issued on October 26. The last date for filing nominations is November 2, while scrutiny will take place on November 3. Candidates can withdraw their nominations until November 5.
Article Summary: Hardeep Puri is set to win the upcoming Rajya Sabha bypoll unopposed from Madhya Pradesh. The bypoll was necessitated by the resignation of former Union minister L Murugan. Congress-backed candidates Rajkumar Lohani and Kante Sayanna were rejected.

Article Title: Presidential election today? Trump confuses India with Brazil, claims 125 million voted
Article Text:
Trump says "125 million Indians voted in presidential election today."

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

US President Donald Trump on Monday confused India with Brazil, claiming that 125 million people had voted in an Indian “presidential election”, while also questioning the integrity of the American voting system.In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote, “125 Million People voted today in the first round of India’s Presidential Election. The results came out shortly after the vote closed, on the same day!”He then compared the alleged election results with the US electoral process, writing, “In Detroit, Philadelphia, California, and numerous other US Cities and States, the results, with much smaller numbers, will often take weeks to Rig, I mean, calculate. Voting in America is corrupt!!!”However, India did not hold a presidential election on Sunday. The President of India is elected indirectly by an electoral college and not through a direct nationwide popular vote.Trump's remarks came after Brazil held the first round of its presidential election on Sunday, with incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro advancing to the October 25 runoff.With 99.99% of the votes counted, Bolsonaro secured 47.03% of the valid votes, while Lula received 45.16%, according to Brazil's Superior Electoral Court.The figure of around 125 million mentioned by Trump is close to Brazil's total valid votes, which stood at about 125.27 million, suggesting he may have confused the Brazilian election with India.Neither Bolsonaro nor Lula crossed the 50% threshold required to win in the first round, triggering the October 25 runoff, BBC reported.Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of former Brazilian president Jair Bolsonaro, outperformed expectations in the first round and finished ahead of Lula. His strong showing has raised the prospect of a shift to the right in Latin America's largest economy.Brazil has used electronic voting for decades, and electoral authorities said the first-round voting process proceeded smoothly.The Organization of American States' electoral observation mission said “the voting has been going smoothly and under adequate safety conditions.”The rapid announcement of results has also been cited as a strength of Brazil's electronic voting system.“When results take a lot of time, it creates an opening for people to cast doubt on the results, to say there’s been a problem,” Josemar Lauriano Pereira, a 46-year-old lawyer in Rio de Janeiro, told the Associated Press.Trump's post drew reactions on social media, with users pointing out that India does not elect its president through a direct popular vote.One user posted, “Trump living in a different world? Is a presidential election taking place in India? President Donald Trump made the incorrect claim that 125 million people voted in India's "presidential election" today.”Another said, “What is my blud Donald Trump smoking? Why is he mentioning India instead of Brazil when talking about the election?”
Article Summary: US President Donald Trump confused India with Brazil, claiming that 125 million people had voted in an Indian "presidential election" He also questioned the integrity of the American voting system. India did not hold a presidential election on Sunday. The President of India is elected indirectly by an electoral college.

Article Title: "She was the hardest to win": Andre Agassi revealed why Steffi Graf saying yes meant more than winning a Grand Slam
Article Text:
Steffi Graf-Andre Agassi (Getty Images)

Andre Agassi's pursuit of Steffi Graf began at Wimbledon in 1992

Steffi Graf became Andre Agassi's hardest-fought victory

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Two years ago, Andre Agassi offered a glimpse into one of tennis's most enduring love stories, revealing that his greatest personal victory had nothing to do with lifting a Grand Slam trophy. For the eight-time major champion, winning Steffi Graf's heart was a challenge unlike anything he had faced on court. Their romance took years to develop, survived complicated personal circumstances and eventually grew into a marriage built on respect, humour and family. Even after decades together, Agassi's words made it clear that Graf remained his most meaningful achievement.The story began in 1992, when both tennis stars were enjoying remarkable success. Agassi had developed a strong attraction to Graf after watching her during a French television interview. He even tried to contact her following the 1991 French Open, but received no response.Their paths finally crossed after Agassi won his first Wimbledon men's singles title by defeating Goran Ivanišević. Graf had already claimed the women's championship. Agassi was excited about meeting her at the traditional Wimbledon Champions' Ball, where the winners usually shared a dance.However, the organisers cancelled the dance that year. Graf later joked about her role in the decision, saying, "I worked them real hard to cancel it," before explaining that she had never learned to dance properly.Although the two champions met and posed for photographs, romance did not follow immediately. Graf was dating racing driver Michael Bartels, while Agassi later married actress Brooke Shields in 1997. Their marriage ended in 1999.Their relationship took a new direction in 1999 when Agassi arranged a practice session with Graf during the Key Biscayne tournament in Florida. He began making efforts to get closer to her, sending flowers and carefully planning how to express his feelings.During a flight to London between the French Open and Wimbledon, Agassi even turned an airline menu into a birthday card for Graf. He eventually made his intentions clear, telling her:"So I need to tell you, I just need to say before we go any further, that I think you are beautiful. I respect you, I admire you, and I would absolutely love to get to know you better. That's my goal. That's my only agenda."Their romance developed quickly. Graf ended her relationship with Bartels, and the couple went public in September 1999.They married on October 22, 2001, in a private ceremony at Agassi's Las Vegas home, with their mothers serving as the only witnesses. Reflecting on the moment, Agassi told Forbes India, "She was the hardest to win… when Steffi Graf says yes, it's as close to arriving."The couple welcomed son Jaden four days after their wedding and daughter Jaz in 2003. They later focused on family life, charitable work and business ventures.Agassi summed up his admiration for Graf beautifully during her 2004 Women's Tennis Hall of Fame induction, saying, "You've spent many years of your life competing, but right here where we stand, in the ears of your children and right now in my heart, you have no rival."Graf returned the affection with her own memorable words: "Tennis has been a journey, and the best part of this journey is it led to you. I'll be forever grateful for that."
Article Summary: Andre Agassi's pursuit of Steffi Graf began at Wimbledon in 1992. Their romance took years to develop, survived complicated personal circumstances and eventually grew into a marriage built on respect, humour and family. Agassi summed up his admiration for Graf beautifully during her 2004 Women's Tennis Hall of Fame induction.

Article Title: Virat Kohli's 74, Arshdeep Singh's four-wicket haul guide India to victory against New Zealand in rain-hit ODI
Article Text:
Virat Kohli (AP Photo)

India's pace attack dismantles New Zealand

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Rain interruptions disrupt India's chase

Virat Kohli continued his remarkable run in the 50-over format with a commanding 74 as India defeated New Zealand by five wickets in a rain-affected first ODI at Eden Park in Auckland on Wednesday. The visitors chased down a revised target of 143 in 22.4 overs under the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method to take a 1-0 lead in the five-match series.Kohli, who turns 38 on Thursday, brought up his 80th half-century in ODIs with another impressive display of batting in a run chase. The former India captain walked in after Rohit Sharma departed for a six-ball duck in the opening over and immediately took responsibility for rebuilding the innings.The experienced batter joined skipper Shubman Gill at the crease, and the pair stitched together a match-defining 113-run partnership for the second wicket. While Gill played the supporting role with a composed 37, Kohli took charge of the chase, finding boundaries regularly and keeping the required run rate under control.New Zealand pacer Jacob Duffy picked up three wickets for 49 runs to briefly bring the hosts back into the contest.However, India had done enough damage through the Kohli-Gill partnership, and Naman Dhir eventually struck the winning boundary to seal the victory.India finished at 143/5 in 22.4 overs, securing a five-wicket victory and moving ahead in the series.Earlier, India's young pace attack delivered an impressive performance to bowl New Zealand out for 185 in 40.2 overs after Shubman Gill won the toss and elected to field. Arshdeep Singh led the bowling effort with four wickets, while Gurnoor Brar and Anshul Kamboj provided excellent support to keep the home side under constant pressure on a lively Eden Park surface.Arshdeep struck early to remove Will Young for nine before sending Henry Nicholls back to the pavilion for the same score. The left-arm pacer consistently used the bounce on offer and prevented the New Zealand top order from building momentum.Tim Seifert offered some resistance with a 38-run knock off 43 deliveries, which included three boundaries and two sixes. However, Gurnoor Brar eventually ended his stay with a short delivery as substitute fielder Ruturaj Gaikwad completed the catch.Brar continued to trouble the New Zealand batters with his pace and bounce. He also dismissed Tom Latham for three with a sharp return catch, leaving the hosts struggling at 84/4.Daryl Mitchell attempted to stabilise the innings alongside Glenn Phillips, but their partnership was broken following a run-out involving Rohit Sharma and KL Rahul. Mitchell departed for 28, while Phillips managed 30 off 51 deliveries before Arshdeep dismissed him.Anshul Kamboj was particularly impressive in the middle overs, keeping things tight with his disciplined line and length. The Haryana pacer dismissed New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner for four before removing Nathan Smith for one, finishing with figures of 2/22 in 10 overs, including two maidens.Kamboj conceded just 22 runs in his full quota, maintaining an economy rate of 2.20 and delivering 46 dot balls. His spell was among the most economical 10-over performances by an Indian fast bowler in recent years.New Zealand's lower order attempted to push the score towards 200, with Blair Tickner launching an aggressive counter-attack. The pacer smashed 34 off just 23 deliveries, including four sixes, but his efforts were not enough to take the hosts beyond 185.Arshdeep finished with 4/70, Brar claimed 3/44, while Kamboj returned 2/22 as India wrapped up the New Zealand innings in 40.2 overs.India's chase was interrupted by multiple rain delays, with the target eventually revised to 143 in 32 overs under the DLS method. The visitors suffered an early setback when Rohit Sharma was dismissed for a duck by Kyle Jamieson in the opening over. However, Gill and Kohli ensured there was no further damage during the initial phase of the chase.The victory gives India a 1-0 advantage in the five-match ODI series.
Article Summary: India beat New Zealand by five wickets in first ODI at Eden Park. Visitors chased down revised target of 143 in 22.4 overs under Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method. Virat Kohli scored 74 as India took a 1-0 lead in the five-match series.

They say the two share a friendship, but there is no romantic relationship between them.The dating rumors had been circulating online since mid-October. Both Kai Trump and Jake Weinberg attend the University of Miami, which led to questions about whether they were seeing each other.However, neither had publicly spoken about the rumors before TMZ reported the response from Kai's representatives on November 2.Speaking to TMZ, a representative for Kai said, "Kai and Jake are just friends and they are not dating."TMZ also reported that some people had seen the two at a restaurant in Palm Beach recently. Kai is part of the women's golf program, while Weinberg plays for the Miami Hurricanes football team.Kai is the daughter of Donald Trump Jr. and Vanessa Trump. She joined the University of Miami for the 2026-27 academic year and is now in her freshman year.Her main focus at college is golf. She has competed in several junior tournaments and has been working toward her long-term goal of becoming a professional golfer.While his personal life has become a topic of online discussion, Jake Weinberg has also been having a good season on the football field.The Boynton Beach, Florida, native previously played for Florida State before transferring to Miami. More than 12,000 abusive messages targeted female tennis players in 2025

British tennis player Jodie Burrage has revealed that she received death threats and abusive messages after losing her first WTA Tour singles match in 16 months. The 27-year-old shared screenshots of the messages after her first-round defeat at the Chennai Open, questioning why social media platforms had not done more to protect players.Burrage, ranked 474th in the world and Britain's No 15, lost 3-6, 6-3, 7-5 to India's Vaishnavi Adkar in the first round of the Chennai Open. Despite taking the opening set, the British player was unable to prevent Adkar from recovering to win the match in three sets.It was Burrage's first match in the main draw of a WTA Tour event since July 2025, excluding qualifying tournaments. Her previous appearance at that level had ended in a first-round defeat by Catherine McNally at Wimbledon.After the Chennai match, Burrage posted an Instagram story showing a scroll of direct messages she had received. Alongside the video, she wrote: “Nice welcome back to tour. I remember why I left. When will something be done?”She tagged both the WTA and Instagram, directing attention to the abuse and asking what action would be taken against those sending it.One message accused Burrage of being a “quitter” and a “disgrace to the sport”, before attacking women's tennis and telling her to kill herself.It read: “Your [sic] a quitter smh [shake my head]. You truly are a disgrace to the sport. You got your ass whooped today and you are the exact reason women's sports are a joke.“Hope you go home and kill yourself bc [because] honestly that's what's best. You will never compare to a man b***h.”Another pending direct message read: “Die n riot [sic] on the streets”, while a separate message directed at the player said: “F***** [sic] ****”.The messages included personal abuse and encouragement of self-harm, rather than criticism of Burrage's performance. Her post also drew support from fellow players, including Germany's Eva Lys, who shared the issue on Instagram and tagged the WTA, asking: “When will something be done?”Burrage's experience follows a similar case involving fellow British player Katie Boulter, who spoke to BBC Sport in 2025 about receiving death threats and other abusive messages online.Boulter became the target of abuse after losing the first set of her opening-round match against Carole Monnet at the French Open. She went on to win the match, but the result did not prevent users from sending threats to her social media accounts.Screenshots shown to the BBC included one message saying: “Hope you get cancer”. Another threatened to damage her grandmother's grave if she was not dead by the following day, while also referring to “candles and a coffin for your entire family”.A third message read: “Go to hell, I lost money my mother sent me.”The reference to lost money reflected a pattern identified in research into online abuse directed at tennis players. A report by the Signify Group, which monitors threats and abuse through its AI-led threat detection service, found two years ago that angry gamblers were responsible for 48 per cent of posts classified as abusive.The scale of the problem extends beyond individual cases. According to a report published earlier in 2026, female tennis players received more than 12,000 abusive posts and messages on social media during 2025.According to the BBC, data from the Signify Group's threat matrix service showed that the number of abusive posts and messages was similar to the figure recorded in 2024. The report also found that angry gamblers accounted for 42 per cent of verified abuse in 2025 and 59 per cent of cases classified as serious abuse.The findings point to gambling-related anger as a significant source of online hostility towards players, although the abuse received by Burrage and Boulter also included threats and misogynistic attacks unrelated to any assessment of their performances.Players have previously called for social media companies to introduce identity verification measures in an effort to make users more accountable for the messages they send. The WTA's player board has also condemned the abuse, describing it as “unacceptable” and warning that its impact on those targeted can be “significant”.
Article Summary: British tennis player Jodie Burrage received death threats and abusive messages after losing her first WTA Tour singles match in 16 months. Burrage, ranked 474th in the world, lost 3-6, 6-3, 7-5 to India's Vaishnavi Adkar in the first round of the Chennai Open. The 27-year-old shared screenshots of the messages after her first-round defeat. She questioned why social media platforms had not done more to protect players.

Article Title: Josh Allen incident puts Ravens’ $100 million star at risk of NFL discipline as league reviews controversial moment
Article Text:
Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen (Image via Getty)

Roquan Smith faces fresh NFL scrutiny after Josh Allen incident

His previous fine against Tyler Shough makes the situation worse

Ravens fans defend Smith despite growing criticism

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Baltimore Ravens linebacker Roquan Smith could face another NFL fine after his controversial contact with Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen sparked criticism following Sunday's 36-10 defeat. Smith appeared to grab Allen's facemask and pull his head backward during a fourth-quarter sneak, but officials allowed the touchdown to stand without throwing a flag. The incident has drawn attention beyond the result, particularly because Smith was fined for a similar play earlier this season. With his disciplinary record now under scrutiny, the three-time All-Pro could face a more expensive penalty.The incident happened during Buffalo's opening possession. The Bills had reached the goal line and attempted a quarterback sneak with Allen on third down, but Baltimore's defense stopped him short. Buffalo tried again on fourth down, and Allen managed to cross the goal line for the touchdown.However, replays showed Smith grabbing the quarterback's facemask and pulling his head backward as the play unfolded. The officials did not penalize the Ravens linebacker, allowing the touchdown to stand.Allen showed no apparent signs of injury and continued playing. He eventually finished the game with two passing touchdowns and a rushing score as Buffalo secured a comfortable victory.The footage quickly became a talking point among Bills supporters. Dave Myers of the Built in Buffalo podcast was particularly critical of Smith's actions and questioned why the linebacker had not received a suspension.“There’s dirty players, then there is Roquan Smith,” Myers said. “Dude should be suspended for trying to pull Josh Allen’s head off.”That reaction has added pressure on the NFL to examine the play. However, there has been no confirmed announcement of a new fine or suspension against Smith.What makes the latest incident more concerning for Smith is its similarity to an earlier play involving New Orleans Saints quarterback Tyler Shough.During Baltimore's 24-17 defeat to New Orleans on September 20, Shough scored a late fourth-down rushing touchdown with 1:28 remaining. Smith was again accused of grabbing the quarterback's facemask during the goal-line attempt.Officials missed the penalty during the game, but the NFL reviewed the footage and fined Smith $11,941. The decision established a disciplinary precedent that could now work against the Ravens linebacker.According to Heavy, another facemask violation this season could push his fine to $17,911. Smith has also received previous fines for roughing the passer, a horse-collar tackle and another facemask incident.He has never been suspended or ejected during his NFL career. That distinction could become important if the league considers whether his recent actions point to a repeated problem rather than an isolated mistake.The reaction has not been entirely against the Baltimore linebacker. Some Ravens supporters believe Buffalo's decision to repeatedly use Allen on quarterback sneaks exposes its star quarterback to unnecessary physical contact.One fan wrote, “You are running a rugby play and crying that your QB is getting hit in a contact sport! Grow up.”Another added, “Josh Allen does silly stuff and is protected by the rules. He gets hurt; it’s on him.”The disagreement highlights an important distinction. Quarterback sneaks are legal, but defenders must still follow the league's rules on unnecessary contact and player safety. The physical nature of the play does not automatically excuse a facemask grab.Smith signed a five-year, $100 million extension with Baltimore in 2023, becoming the highest-paid off-ball linebacker in NFL history at the time. His contract reflects his importance to the defense, but his value to the Ravens also makes any potential suspension a bigger concern.Baltimore already has problems after losing three consecutive games and falling to 4-4. With Lamar Jackson facing surgery on his right thumb, another setback involving Smith would create an additional headache for the team. The linebacker now faces a difficult week, with his previous punishment making the latest incident harder to dismiss.
Article Summary: Baltimore Ravens linebacker Roquan Smith could face another NFL fine after his controversial contact with Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen. Smith appeared to grab Allen's facemask and pull his head backward during a fourth-quarter sneak. Officials allowed the touchdown to stand without throwing a flag. The incident has drawn attention beyond the result, particularly because Smith was fined for a similar play earlier this season.

Article Title: How Patrick Mahomes’ first Kansas City mansion went from a $1.9M purchase to a $2.9M listing before finding a buyer in under two weeks
Article Text:
Patrick Mahomes (Image via Getty Images)

Patrick Mahomes’ $1.9M Kansas City home featured luxury upgrades

Patrick Mahomes sells Kansas City mansion after listing it for $2.9M

Patrick Mahomes has enjoyed plenty of big wins on the football field, but one of his early real estate moves also proved rewarding. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback bought his first home for $1.9 million in 2019, then put it on the market four years later for $2.9 million. The property found a buyer in less than two weeks, marking a quick end to a memorable chapter in his life. From a dedicated sneaker room to a backyard built for relaxation, the house reflected the lifestyle Mahomes was creating as his NFL career took off.Mahomes purchased the property in February 2019, shortly after winning the NFL's Most Valuable Player award for his remarkable 2018 season. Located at 1257 W. 57th St. in Kansas City's Sunset Hill neighbourhood, the ranch-style house was built in 1953 and sits on approximately 1.4 acres.At the time, Mahomes was still building his life with his then-girlfriend, Brittany Matthews, who later became his wife. The couple invested nearly $400,000 in renovations to transform the property into their first shared home.“This is the first house either of us ever owned,” the quarterback said during a video walkthrough of the renovation work.The home featured an open-plan design, offering plenty of space for everyday living. One room had a particularly personal purpose. It housed Mahomes' sneaker collection, which reportedly reached around 180 pairs at one point.The outdoor space was equally impressive. A heated swimming pool, hot tub and putting green gave the property a resort-like feel. The garage could also accommodate five vehicles, adding another attraction for potential buyers.In June 2023, Mahomes and his family decided to sell the Sunset Hill property. They listed it for $2.9 million, exactly $1 million above the original purchase price.The listing was handled by Cami Jones of ReeceNichols, who highlighted its location and traditional design.“Right off of Country Club Plaza, this stunning ranch style home is in the sought after subdivision of Sunset Hill.”The property attracted a buyer in less than two weeks. A trust connected to Kansas City businessman David “Rall” Bradley III purchased the house in late June. Bradley co-owns BERKS Group, a private equity firm, while his family also operates News-Press & Gazette Co.However, the final selling price was not disclosed, so the actual profit from the transaction remains unknown.Mahomes had already expanded his property portfolio before the sale, purchasing a $3.37 million home in Westlake, Texas, in March 2020. In 2023, the family moved into a much larger estate in Cass County, Missouri.His current mansion features a private football field and a par-3 golf hole, offering a glimpse of how much his lifestyle has evolved since buying his first home.
Article Summary: Patrick Mahomes bought his first home for $1.9 million in 2019. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback then put it on the market four years later. The ranch-style house was built in 1953 and sits on approximately 1.4 acres. The property found a buyer in less than two weeks.

Article Title: Stephen Curry’s projected $203.6M fortune puts LeBron James’ $93.9M earnings in the shade after his $3.9M 76ers decision
Article Text:
Stephen Curry’s $203.6 million earnings leave LeBron James trailing

LeBron James’ $3.9 million 76ers contract changes NBA earnings race

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Stephen Curry is heading towards a financial milestone that could put him in a league of his own. The Golden State Warriors superstar is projected to earn an astonishing $203.6 million over the coming year, creating a huge gap between him and some of basketball's biggest names. LeBron James remains a commercial powerhouse, but his decision to accept a veteran-minimum contract with the Philadelphia 76ers has changed the financial picture. The difference highlights how Curry has turned his success on the court into an enormous business empire.Curry has secured the top position on Forbes' 2026 list of the NBA's highest-paid players for a second consecutive year. His projected earnings include $62.6 million from basketball and another $141 million from endorsements and business ventures.The off-court figure is particularly striking. It represents a significant increase from the estimated $100 million he generated through commercial activities the previous year.One of the biggest developments behind Curry's growing business portfolio is his partnership with Chinese sportswear company Li-Ning. After ending his relationship with Under Armour in 2025, the Warriors guard agreed to a 10-year deal worth $400 million.The agreement includes a signature footwear collection expected to launch early next year. It gives Curry another major platform to build his brand beyond the NBA.According to Forbes, Curry is the first active NBA player projected to cross $200 million in earnings over a 12-month period. Only Floyd Mayweather, Cristiano Ronaldo and Jon Rahm have previously reached that mark among athletes tracked by the publication.James has slipped to fourth place on the list after spending 11 consecutive seasons at the top of NBA earnings rankings.His projected income stands at $93.9 million, including approximately $90 million from endorsements and business interests. However, his latest contract decision has reduced his basketball earnings considerably.The 76ers signed the veteran superstar to a minimum deal worth approximately $3.9 million. That decision puts his projected total at less than half of Curry's expected earnings.Kevin Durant occupies second place with $104.9 million, while Giannis Antetokounmpo follows at $103.5 million. Anthony Edwards and Jayson Tatum round out the top six with $87.9 million and $86.5 million, respectively.The wider numbers reveal just how valuable NBA stars have become outside basketball. The ten highest-paid players are projected to generate a combined $958 million, with $469 million coming from endorsements and commercial ventures.For Curry, the achievement goes beyond his basketball salary. At 38, he has built a business portfolio that continues to grow even as the competition for NBA earnings intensifies. James remains one of the sport's biggest commercial names, but Curry currently holds the financial advantage.
Article Summary: Stephen Curry is projected to earn an astonishing $203.6 million over the coming year. The Golden State Warriors star has turned his success on the court into an enormous business empire. LeBron James remains a commercial powerhouse, but his decision to accept a veteran-minimum contract with the Philadelphia 76ers has changed the financial picture.

Cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar has offered an insight into his unsuccessful stints as India's captain, admitting that he did not always have complete control over team selection during his leadership years in the 1990s.Tendulkar, who represented India across formats during an international career spanning 24 years, addressed the subject during an 'Ask Me Anything' session on Reddit on Tuesday. He also named his favourite Indian captains and shared his admiration for South Africa skipper Temba Bavuma The batting great, who made his international debut on November 15, 1989, and retired on November 16, 2013, described leading India as a tremendous honour. However, he acknowledged that the role came with limitations, particularly when it came to choosing the playing XI."It was a great honour to lead the team as captain. However, I didn’t always have the freedom to pick my team entirely on my own. The BCCI today is a far more professional organisation than it was in the 1990s. Indian cricket also went through a particularly dark phase during that period," Tendulkar said.Despite his stature as one of the greatest batters in the history of the game, Tendulkar's two separate spells as India's captain in the 1990s did not produce the desired results.When asked about his preferred leaders, the former India captain picked Sourav Ganguly and MS Dhoni , both of whom played significant roles in shaping Indian cricket."As far as my favourite captains go, Sourav Ganguly and MS Dhoni would definitely be at the top of my list!!," Tendulkar said.Both captains shared memorable World Cup moments with Tendulkar. Under Ganguly, India reached the final of the 2003 ODI World Cup in South Africa, finishing as runners-up.Dhoni, meanwhile, led India to the 2011 ODI World Cup title on home soil, allowing Tendulkar to fulfil his long-standing dream of winning the tournament.Tendulkar also had words of appreciation for South Africa captain Temba Bavuma, praising the right-handed batter for leading his team from the front and producing impressive results."I truly admire Temba Bavuma’s spirit. He has led from the front and delivered some remarkable results for South Africa cricket. South Africa winning an ICC title is great for world cricket!"Bavuma's leadership has been backed by strong performances from the Proteas, including their 2-1 Test series victory over Australia in a three-match contest.The South African captain played a key role in the turnaround, scoring a career-best 179 in the second Test. In the series-deciding third Test at Newlands, off-spinner Simon Harmer delivered a match-winning performance, claiming 10 wickets in the game, including figures of 6/16 in the second innings.Harmer's efforts helped South Africa dismiss Australia for just 111 on the final day and seal the series 2-1.
Article Summary: Sachin Tendulkar says he did not always have complete control over team selection during his leadership years in the 1990s. The batting great also named his favourite Indian captains and shared his admiration for South Africa skipper Temba Bavuma. The former India captain retired from international cricket in November 2013.

Article Title: A Hardik Pandya fan, Rohan Rajbhar slams maiden ton; dedicates milestone to mother after anchoring Rajasthan’s recovery alongside Mahipal Lomror
Article Text:
Rohan Rajbhar

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Playing only his fourth First-Class match, Rohan Rajbhar scored his maiden century, bringing up 140 off 263 balls with 11 fours and a six, as Rajasthan secured a lead of 222 runs against Himachal Pradesh on Day Two of their Group ‘D’ Ranji Trophy match in Dharamshala on Tuesday.Displaying rock-solid defence and executing exquisite strokes, Rohan anchored Rajasthan’s powerful comeback alongside Mahipal Lomror (97 off 190), with whom he stitched a crucial partnership of 209 runs.Upon reaching the landmark hundred, Rohan soaked in the applause, took off his helmet, and pulled out a piece of paper from his pocket to reveal a heartfelt message written on it: ‘Thank You Maa’. His marathon knock finally came to an end when he was stumped off an Abhishek Kumar delivery.For the 20-year-old, the milestone is the sweet fruit of an arduous journey born out of humble beginnings. His father, Vijay, who works as a POP (Plaster of Paris) contractor, always wanted his son to become a cricketer, so he sent Rohan to a cricket academy when he was just four years old. To make sure his son did not miss out on the opportunity, the father even borrowed money initially to cover the fees and buy his son the cricket gear.Growing up in a cramped one-room house where fans had to be switched off while his mother cooked in the shared space, Rohan learned early on what grit truly means. Reflecting on his special celebration, Rohan told TOI, “The message written on the paper was for my mother. She has never been able to watch my matches live at the stadium anywhere, so I knew she would be watching it on TV today. This hundred was for her.”He also credited senior pro Mahipal for steering him through tense moments. “Even on Day One when things weren’t going well, Mahipal bhai came up to me in the evening and kept encouraging me, telling me that I belong at this level and will do well. Out in the middle too, whenever my scoring slowed down or I played a reckless shot, he constantly guided and supported me.”That steely temperament draws deep inspiration from his idol, Hardik Pandya , whose peace symbol tattoo Rohan sports on his neck. The youngster’s admiration goes beyond cricket. He still vividly remembers when Hardik faced hostile booing across stadiums in India after he left Gujarat Titans and returned to Mumbai Indians as captain. “I had gone to see an IPL match at the SMS Stadium in 2024. I felt bad seeing a section of the spectators booing Hardik. I have great respect for him because of the way he has conducted himself in the face of criticism, and in life in general,” Rohan added.Meanwhile, the day belonged entirely to Rajasthan's remarkable redemption. Having been bundled out for a paltry 78 in their first innings, the visitors staged a phenomenal turnaround. After a disciplined first session where they lost just one wicket, the visitors pressed home their advantage with complete authority. It was only after tea that three wickets fell, including a heartbreaking end for Mahipal, who fell just three runs short of a well-deserved hundred after being caught by the wicketkeeper off medium-pacer Arpit Guleria.At stumps, Rajasthan reached a commanding 297/4, with captain Kartik Sharma and Vishal Harsh at the crease.
Article Summary: Rohan Rajbhar scored 140 off 263 balls with 11 fours and a six. He anchored Rajasthan’s powerful comeback alongside Mahipal Lomror (97 off 190), with whom he stitched a crucial partnership of 209 runs. The 20-year-old was playing only his fourth First-Class match.

Article Title: AK47 finds the target: Relentless Anshul Kamboj reaps benefits of better planning
Article Text:
Anshul Kamboj celebrates the wicket of New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner during the one day cricket international between New Zealand and India in Auckland, New Zealand.

The unfamiliar feeling

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

AUCKLAND: A day before members of India's ODI squad were scheduled to train at the Eden Park, Anshul Kamboj was out for a stroll with Ruturaj Gaikwad. The two grabbed a quick bite at a fast-food joint near a busy setting for a Diwali fair, obliged fans with some pictures, and then slipped out largely unnoticed. The 25-year-old Kamboj, still four sleeps away from eventually his second ODI appearance, looked relaxed following proper training, adequate rest and timely communication.The right-arm seamer would bowl relentlessly to the likes of Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma in the nets on November 1, enjoy a bowling rest the following day, and then apply the finishing touches on the eve of the seriesopener against New Zealand.Given his chaotic entry into Test and ODI cricket, the preparations felt too good to be true. Much like his dreamy outing in the series opener against the Black Caps.Kamboj has had forgettable outings in international cricket but he ensured Auckland didn't follow the pattern. With relentless lengths, sharp use of the wobble seam and speeds, the highly-rated Haryana bowler showed why the management didn't give up on him.Throughout his spells, Kamboj didn't miss his spot even when the opponents tried to unsettle him by charging down the ground, reaping rewards both for himself and the team for his persistence.‘’One match doesn’t decide a career… I have been doing same things. I got motivation to do well after Manchester Test. I dont pay attention to outside talk,’’ Kamboj said at the post-match press conference.When you prepare well, it gives you confidence so and ensures there are no surprises in the match,” he said about the preparation.When Kamboj sucked the momentum out of the New Zealand batting, Gurnoor Brar and Arshdeep Singh added to the wickets tally from the other end. Nearly half the Kiwi side was back in the hut when Kamboj finished his first spell (5-1-12-0) — leaving the hosts' hopes of a big total to a lower-order miracle. Axar Patel was introduced to give the seamers a breather and the short break further fired up Kamboj as he cranked up speeds flirting around the 140 kmph mark in his second spell.“Dimensions were different but it doesn’t matter when there is help off the pitch,” Kamboj said about the venue.The relentlessness paid off as he picked the wickets of Mitchell Santner and Nathan Smith in consecutive overs, leaving mere formalities to be completed. The next five overs improved upon the first spell, capping off an incisive spell of fast bowling.Auckland must have given Kamboj an unfamiliar feeling, as he isn't used to normalcy as far as international cricket is concerned. This time, however, the preparation and planning were spot on. He wasn't an injury replacement taking a long international flight or switching formats after a quick flight from South to East India.The plan to give up on him after ordinary Test and ODI debuts was never on the table as the management always believed in his abilities. When he returned to the set-up after the Manchester Test, his increased pace immediately caught attention.The think-tank was impressed with the drastic improvement and was keen on giving him consistent gametime even after the Guwahati ODI against West Indies.When the Windies took Kamboj to the cleaners, India captain Shubman Gill backed the under-fire quick and asserted that both Auqib Nabi and Kamboj would continue to be in the mix.“It's not easy to come and be able to deliver straight away,” Gill had said.“Anshul and Auqib are the kind of players who are going to be in the mix a lot. And Anshul is someone who can also bat at number 8. And that number is very crucial for us,” he further added.Selectors heard the captain, kept the two in the mix and with meticulous planning, helped Haryana's AK47 find the target. Short, good lengths were the order of the day and with razor sharp precision, Kamboj hit the spot to keep India on top.
Article Summary: Anshul Kamboj picked up two wickets in consecutive overs against New Zealand. Haryana bowler has had forgettable outings in international cricket but he ensured Auckland didn't follow the pattern. India captain Shubman Gill backed the under-fire quick and asserted that both Auqib Nabi and KamboJ would continue to be in the mix.

Article Title: Aryna Sabalenka reveals what happened when she teamed up with Tom Brady and David Beckham for an unexpected Holiday project
Article Text:
Aryna Sabalenka joins Kevin Hart, David Beckham and Tom Brady for SharkNinja’s new holiday campaign (SharkNinja)

Sabalenka shares her experience working with Tom Brady and David Beckham

Aryna Sabalenka explains why SharkNinja products fit her routine

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

Aryna Sabalenka has added an unusual holiday assignment to her busy tennis schedule, joining Tom Brady, David Beckham and Kevin Hart for SharkNinja's latest Christmas campaign. The world No. 1 enjoyed the experience more than she expected, particularly because of the company she kept on set. In an interview with Parade, Sabalenka spoke about filming the comedy-filled commercial, her familiarity with SharkNinja products and the role one of its hair tools plays in her routine. She also offered a glimpse into how her family celebrates Christmas.The new campaign, titled "There's No Home Like a SharkNinja Home," brings together four familiar faces for a holiday comedy. Hart plays Beckham's house-sitter while the former England captain enjoys a tropical getaway. Things quickly get out of hand when Hart invites Sabalenka and Brady over.The commercial has no shortage of unusual moments. Hart prepares a turkey using the Ninja Crispi Pro, while Sabalenka helps herself to a frozen drink from the Ninja SLUSHi machine. Brady, meanwhile, wanders around wearing a Shark CryoGlow red light therapy mask and even shakes presents under the Christmas tree.The trouble begins when Hart accidentally breaks a picture frame while vacuuming.Beckham, who has been keeping an eye on his home through a surveillance system, decides to return early. Hart then tries to make things right by offering his unexpected guest a slushie.For Sabalenka, the fun was not limited to what viewers see in the finished advertisement. She said the people involved made the shoot particularly enjoyable."It was so fun," Sabalenka told Parade in an exclusive interview. "The whole campaign is super-fun and when I was told the idea, I was like, ‘Wow that's amazing. I want to jump right in.'"She also enjoyed working alongside Brady and Hart, adding, "Plus these guys, like Kevin and Tom, honestly I was laughing the whole time and the whole idea of the campaign was perfect."The advertisement is the latest chapter in SharkNinja's Neighbors series, which began in 2025 with Beckham and Hart playing next-door neighbors. Earlier instalments featured Beckham's friends enjoying his household products while pretending they were not visiting his home.The partnership also made sense outside the commercial. Sabalenka was already using several products from the brand before joining the campaign."I always have a bunch of SharkNinja products at home, including a slushie machine," she explained. "And then, I got introduced to the hair styler, which I love and have been using ever since. I've always had their products, so that's why it was a perfect match."One product she particularly likes is the Shark Glam Hair Styler. Sabalenka said it has become a regular part of getting ready, especially when she wants curls without spending too much time on her hair."I'm no professional but I always do my curls with the SharkNinja and it's great," she said. "It's super-easy to use, even if you're not a pro with styling."She also pointed to hair care as an important reason for using the device. Frequent styling can be a concern, particularly for someone who regularly travels and maintains a demanding athletic routine."It's so good because it's not damaging your hair and that's very important," she explained. "As an athlete, with my hair condition, I'm always trying to use a lot of products for my hair and then, when you have a good hair dryer that's not damaging your hair? It's a game-changer."Sabalenka's Christmas celebrations are much more family-focused than the chaos in the advertisement. She said the occasion usually involves a large dinner, cooking together and dressing up for the gathering."It's always a family dinner and family time," she told Parade. "We cook a lot. We like to look good so we dress up."There is still plenty to manage before everyone sits down to eat. As Sabalenka joked, getting ready while preparing food can be difficult, making the hair styler useful during the rush."But you have to cook for everyone and you don't have much time, so that's why it's a double win because it saves you time," she said.SharkNinja's holiday campaign launched on November 3, bringing Sabalenka into a commercial alongside two of the most recognisable names in global sport.
Article Summary: Aryna Sabalenka joins Kevin Hart, David Beckham and Tom Brady for SharkNinja’s new holiday campaign (SharkNinja) The world No. 1 shares her experience working with Tom Brady and David Beckham for the campaign. She also talks about the role one of its hair tools plays in her routine.

Article Title: “I also know how much it means to have mom”: How Jason and Travis Kelce's mom Donna is turning her experience of raising two NFL stars into a mission to bring grandparents closer to youth sports
Article Text:
Jason and Travis Kelce's mom Donna is turning her experience of raising two NFL stars into a mission to bring grandparents closer to youth sports(Image via Getty Images)

From raising Travis Kelce and Jason Kelce to cheering for another generation

How Donna Kelce's Gran Cave campaign is bringing grandparents closer to youth sports

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

For Donna Kelce, supporting young athletes is nothing new. She spent years cheering for Travis Kelce and Jason Kelce as they worked towards their football dreams. Now, with both sons established in the NFL and Jason raising four daughters, Donna has found a new way to stay connected to the next generation of young athletes.On May 18, 2026, the mother of the Kansas City Chiefs tight end and former Philadelphia Eagles center joined hands with GameChanger for its 'Gran Cave' campaign. The initiative aims to help grandparents follow their grandchildren's sporting journeys, even when they cannot attend games in person.Donna Kelce understands the commitment that comes with raising children who love sports. Travis and Jason grew up playing several sports, including football, basketball, baseball, hockey and lacrosse. Both eventually chose football in seventh grade, setting them on a path that would take them to the University of Cincinnati and later the NFL.Jason Kelce went on to become a Super Bowl champion with the Philadelphia Eagles, while Travis Kelce built his legacy with the Kansas City Chiefs. Donna experienced some unforgettable moments along the way, including Super Bowl LVII in February 2023, when her two sons faced each other in the championship game.However, her connection to youth sports did not end when her sons became professionals. Jason and his wife, Kylie Kelce, now have four daughters: Wyatt, Elliotte, Bennett and Finnley. Donna, whom the girls call 'DeeDee', has another generation of young family members to cheer for.That experience makes her latest partnership particularly personal. In a statement released by GameChanger on May 18, 2026, Donna spoke about the difficulty of attending every game and the importance of family support."I know firsthand how challenging it is to be at every game in person, and I also know how much it means to have mom or grandma cheering you on from afar," she said.She also explained her excitement about helping another family create a similar experience. "GameChanger makes that connection possible, and I'm so excited to help award one family their own Gran Cave so they can support the most important players in their lives," Donna added in the campaign announcement.Donna's partnership with GameChanger gives that message a practical purpose. The youth sports platform offers live streaming, allowing family members to follow games even when distance prevents them from watching in person.For the campaign, Donna introduced her own 'Gran Cave', a dedicated sports-viewing space featuring large LCD screens showing youth games. It also included photographs of Travis and Jason from their younger sporting days and a decorated jersey carrying her nickname, 'DeeDee'.The idea goes beyond creating a comfortable place to watch games. GameChanger wants grandparents to remain part of their grandchildren's sporting experiences, particularly when they have several young athletes playing for different teams or living in different states.GameChanger President Sameer Ahuja explained the need for such a setup in the May 18, 2026, campaign announcement."At GameChanger, we believe that every young athlete deserves to have their village watching and supporting them for every moment, near or far," Ahuja said.He also shared the platform's findings, revealing that more than 83% of games streamed on GameChanger had viewers from outside the team's home state. The average game attracted viewers from more than three states."For grandparents, keeping up with multiple grandkids across different teams can be a logistical challenge, but the desire to make every game remains the same," Ahuja added.GameChanger opened nominations for the Gran Cave contest on May 18, 2026, and accepted entries until May 31. One grandparent was set to receive a customised Gran Cave, while 365 others could win first-prize subscriptions.In Donna's case, the partnership brings her journey as a sports mother into her life as a grandmother. She once watched Travis and Jason chase their NFL dreams from the sidelines. Now, she wants more grandparents to enjoy those same special moments with the young athletes in their families, even from miles away.
Article Summary: Donna Kelce is turning her experience of raising two NFL stars into a mission to bring grandparents closer to youth sports. The mother of the Kansas City Chiefs tight end and former Philadelphia Eagles center joined hands with GameChanger for its 'Gran Cave' campaign. The initiative aims to help grandparents follow their grandchildren's sporting journeys.

Article Title: "We've had a lot of highs and lows": Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes’ $325 million KC Current face a major test as Angel City arrive for NWSL playoffs
Article Text:
Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes (Getty Images)

Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes’ KC Current prepare for Angel City FC

KC Current home advantage could prove vital in NWSL playoffs

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

The Kansas City Current have another chance to turn their home advantage into a defining postseason moment. With Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes among the club’s ownership group, the team has built a strong identity in Kansas City. Now, after securing a home playoff match, the Current will look to take another step towards the 2026 NWSL title when they welcome Angel City FC to CPKC Stadium on November 7.Kansas City Chiefs secured the fourth seed in the 2026 NWSL playoffs and earned the right to host fifth-seeded Angel City FC in the quarterfinals. Kick-off is scheduled for 11 a.m. local time on Saturday, November 7, giving the Current a valuable opportunity to start their postseason campaign in front of their own supporters.The Mahomes family’s involvement has added a high-profile sporting connection to the club. Patrick and Brittany Mahomes are part of the ownership group behind the Current, a team that has become an important part of Kansas City's growing sports culture.The club has also given its supporters plenty to celebrate this season. Kansas City scored 54 goals during the regular season and continued to show why opponents find trips to CPKC Stadium so difficult.The Current have gone more than 30 consecutive regular-season home games without a defeat at the venue. That record gives them confidence heading into a knockout match, where one result can decide whether a season continues or ends.The players have made it clear that the atmosphere inside CPKC Stadium plays a major role in their performances. Midfielder Lo'eau LaBonta summed up the feeling, saying, "It is just different when you play at CPKC," Current midfielder Lo'eau LaBonta said.Croix Bethune has also enjoyed a record-breaking campaign. On October 25, she registered her 11th assist of the season and sixth game-winning assist against Washington, setting new NWSL single-season records in both categories.Bethune believes the stadium gives Kansas City something special. "It's just something that you can't experience in any other stadium," Bethune said.She also highlighted the importance of earning a home playoff fixture. "It's huge for us. Having a home game, especially for the playoffs, is a big statement that we can make," Bethune said.LaBonta acknowledged the challenges the team faced throughout the campaign, making the achievement even more meaningful. "This year we've had a lot of highs and lows, so it truly felt like we really just fought for this and got to the playoffs and fought for a home game," LaBonta said.The midfielder also credited the supporters for creating an intimidating atmosphere for visiting teams. "For the home team, us, it means everything. It's our 12th player," LaBonta said. "You know you're already down a man because our fans just bring the noise."Against Angel City, that support could become a major factor as the Mahomes-backed Current chase another memorable playoff run.
